_about: Canonical public terms of the resource: what each word means where a reader meets it, where it first appears, which synonyms are allowed, and which uses are ambiguous. app/release_check.mjs fails if a prohibited phrase appears in the app or the science notes. Edit here; keep prose natural — this guards meaning, not word choice.

terms.meaning: the continuous intergalactic medium between the quasar and us — mostly ionised hydrogen and helium
intergalactic medium; used in the science notes and provenance, not on the surface
a teaching summary of one stretch of the continuous gas: a smooth Gaussian clump with one place, motion, temperature and neutral amount (Beats 6–10)

prohibited.why: a parcel or pixel is not a discrete cloud (SCI-REP-003)

terms.meaning: a contiguous stretch of gas grouped for display when a colour is traced back (Beat 12)
two senses, kept apart: a length of the sightline ("this 4.4 Mpc/h stretch") and the redshift stretching of light (Beat 5: "the light stretches"); the gas is a "denser part", never a "denser stretch"

prohibited.phrase: denser stretch of the continuous gas
prohibited.why: in Beat 5 'stretch' means the light's stretching; say 'denser part'

terms.meaning: a denser part of the continuous gas along the light's path (Beat 5) — never a separate object
Beat 13 only: a denser part of the continuous gas, idealised as one smooth clump in a constructed degeneracy example

prohibited.why: in provenance outside Beat 13, the gas is not a cloud

terms.meaning: a representative neutral hydrogen atom, drawn as a dark dot — a cartoon sample, never a count

prohibited.why: atoms are dark dots; ink is optical depth

terms.meaning: a particle or cell of a hydrodynamic simulation; never drawn — the data are a declared toy, not a simulation

prohibited.why: the volume is a toy, not a simulation

terms.meaning: a contribution to optical depth τ, laid in velocity space (Beats 6–13)

prohibited.why: ink is optical depth, not neutral hydrogen
the transmitted flux is never ink

terms.meaning: τ: how strongly the gas dims one colour; contributions add (Beat 9)

prohibited.why: cells place optical depth; 'opacity' is reserved for the drawing's layer opacity 1 − e^−τ

terms.meaning: removal of a colour from the beam — physically, resonant scattering out of the line of sight
F = e^−τ: the fraction of the expected light that arrives at that colour (between 0 and 1; noise aside)
two uses, always distinguished: a parcel's own motion (peculiar velocity, an arrow) and the velocity-space coordinate u = aH·x + v_pec where its ink lands
the observed wavelength of the light, read on the velocity axis (Δu = c Δln λ)
λ, in Å; 'measured here' means by an observer at rest in the expanding universe at that point

prohibited.why: Lyα is 1215.67 Å in the absorber's frame; the forest lies blueward only in the quasar's frame

terms.meaning: comoving distance along the beam, in Mpc/h

prohibited.phrase: along the whole sightline: the Lyman-alpha forest
prohibited.why: the toy stretch is 20 Mpc/h; the distance to us is not to scale

terms.meaning: the observed-colour axis u in km/s, where the gas's ink lands
absorber's rest frame (Lyα at 1215.67 Å), our frame (observed), the quasar's rest frame — always named
public text names drawn colours plainly — red (the current causal focus) and grey; 'cinnabar' and 'pencil' are internal design tokens
